'''2010 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Jacob Taylor LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jacob Taylor]] at [[2010 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' WYS
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
